nodes.label: Flet 0.28.3 GUI Framework
nodes.rationale: Single pinned cross-platform Python GUI framework used across all labs; one codebase runs as desktop, web, or packaged mobile app.

nodes.label: GitHub repo J4ve/cccs106-projects
nodes.rationale: Venv removed from tracking and .gitignore replaced to fix sync problems.

nodes.label: Lab 1 Report: Environment Setup and Python Basics
nodes.norm_label: lab 1 report: environment setup and python basics
nodes.rationale: Interpreter path set via python.defaultInterpreterPath in settings.json because the workspace sits outside cccs106-projects; venv was corrupted after moving directories.

nodes.label: Lab 2 Report: Git Version Control and Flet GUI Development
nodes.norm_label: lab 2 report: git version control and flet gui development

nodes.label: Search History with Persistent Storage (search_history.json)
nodes.rationale: Retyping the same cities is tedious; also practice for file I/O and state management. Keeps last 10 unique cities, most recent first; load history before building dropdown.

nodes.label: Multiple Cities Comparison with Watchlist (watchlist.json)
nodes.rationale: Users check several places; watchlist persists cities and a 3-per-row comparison grid loads fast from cache. Sequential fetch loop kept simple; failed cities are skipped.

nodes.label: Weather Data Caching and Offline Mode
nodes.norm_label: weather data caching and offline mode
nodes.rationale: Reuse already-fetched data instead of erroring on network hiccups. JSON cache files with timestamps, 30-min expiry; when online always fetch fresh, when offline serve even expired cache with a 'last updated' banner. Geolocation entries keyed by coordinates.

nodes.label: 5-Day Weather Forecast with Tabbed Interface
nodes.rationale: Current weather alone felt incomplete for planning. Groups 40 three-hour entries by date (dict keyed by date), takes min/max temps and most common condition per day.

nodes.label: Current Location Weather via IP Geolocation
nodes.norm_label: current location weather via ip geolocation
nodes.rationale: One-click local weather without typing: IP -> lat/lon via ipgeolocation.io, then OpenWeather by coordinates; reuses the existing loading/error/display code.
